args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Confirmed via deployment history that the latest healthy production release was v2.3.0. Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west); rollback completed and service now reporting v2.3.0 across regions. Follow-up for on-call: investigate v2.3.1 for the root cause of the health-check failures and fix before re-release, and confirm error rates return to baseline on v2.3.0.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, unhealthy in all production regions with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback verified complete.
3. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) at checkout-api, documenting the failure of v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up for on-call: root-cause the v2.3.1 regressions and monitor that error rates return to baseline on v2.3.0.
